78034 [see DMG memo 02/25] Claimants with no partner are treated as being severely disabled and are

entitled to the lower rate of additional amount for the severely disabled if 1


1. they are in receipt of


        1.1 “AA” or


        1.2 the care component of DLA at the highest or middle rate or


        1.3 the daily living component of PIP at the standard or enhanced rate or


        1.4 the daily living component of ADP at the standard or enhanced rate or


        1.5 AFIP and


2. there are no persons aged 18 or over


        2.1 normally residing with the claimant or


        2.2 who the claimant normally resides with (see DMG 78065 et seq) and


3. no one is entitled to and in receipt of CA, or UC that includes the carers element, in respect of caring
for them.


                                                                    1 SPC Regs, reg 6(5)(a); Sch I, para 1(1)(a)


Transitional protection
78035 [see DMG memo 02/25] Carers who were aged 65 and over before 28.10.02 can continue to be

entitled to CA even though they are no longer providing care1, for example after the disabled person has
died.


                                  1 The Regulatory Reform (Carer’s Allowance) Order 2002, S.I. 2002/1457
